sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: Chalkboard demonstrates real-time WebSocket expertise with sub-50ms latency and 1000+ messages per second throughput. The p5.js canvas integration enables smooth collaborative drawing across 50+ concurrent users, showcasing scalable bidirectional communication architecture.

sections.title: Real-Time Success
highlights: <50ms WebSocket message latency for real-time feel
50+ concurrent users supported with stable performance
User presence tracking with automatic cleanup
Security middleware protecting against XSS and rate abuse

sections.title: Technical Learnings
sections.summary: Chalkboard revealed critical WebSocket scaling challenges including state persistence (Redis needed for production), connection clustering for horizontal scaling, and CPU optimization for canvas rendering. These learnings directly informed enterprise real-time architecture decisions.

infrastructure.name: Monorepo Structure
Docker Configuration
infrastructure.code:
# Multi-stage Dockerfile for production
FROM node:14-alpine AS builder

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy package files
COPY package.json yarn.lock ./
COPY client/package.json ./client/
COPY server/package.json ./server/

# Install dependencies
RUN yarn install --frozen-lockfile

# Copy source code
COPY . .

# Build client
RUN yarn build

# Production stage
FROM node:14-alpine

WORKDIR /app

# Copy built application
COPY --from=builder /app/server ./server
COPY --from=builder /app/client/build ./client/build
COPY --from=builder /app/package.json ./
COPY --from=builder /app/yarn.lock ./

# Install production dependencies only
RUN yarn install --production --frozen-lockfile

# Expose port
EXPOSE 3000

# Start server
CMD ["yarn", "start"]
